Task: Bulk Modulus of Aluminum
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of aluminum by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for aluminum. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-134
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

IMPORTANT: You have access to filesystem tools. All files will be saved in your isolated workspace.
 Save all the files in /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_1 when using tools use this path.


You must think what to do next. You can use some of the tools available in the system.

When you think that the task is completed, you can submit the answer.
For that, answer with: "Final Answer: <your answer>". It is very important to follow this format.

1. First, let's get the aluminum structure from Materials Project (mp-134)
2. Convert it to LAMMPS format
3. Create and run the LAMMPS simulation to calculate elastic constants
4. Process the results to get the bulk modulus

function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_1/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Al.data

# EAM potential for Al
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Al_nist.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Calculate elastic constants
fix 3 all box/relax aniso 0.0
fix_modify 3 energy yes

# Define elastic constants calculation
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable down equal -${up}

# Elastic constants calculation
variable etol equal 1.0e-10
variable ftol equal 1.0e-10
variable maxiter equal 100000
variable maxeval equal 100000

# Initial energy
minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}
variable e0 equal pe

# Deformation steps for C11
variable delta equal ${up}
change_box all x delta 0 ${delta} remap units box
minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}
variable C11 equal -(pe-${e0})/(${delta}*vol)

# Reset box
change_box all x delta 0 ${down} remap units box
minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}

# Deformation steps for C22
change_box all y delta 0 ${delta} remap units box
minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}
variable C22 equal -(pe-${e0})/(${delta}*vol)

# Reset box
change_box all y delta 0 ${down} remap units box
minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}

# Deformation steps for C33
change_box all z delta 0 ${delta} remap units box
minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}
variable C33 equal -(pe-${e0})/(${delta}*vol)

# Calculate Bulk Modulus (Voigt average)
variable B equal (${C11}+${C22}+${C33})/9.0

# Output results
print "C11 = ${C11} GPa"
print "C22 = ${C22} GPa"
print "C33 = ${C33} GPa"
print "Bulk Modulus = ${B} GPa""}
